text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B, D, and E after gains may have locked in profits but also risks cutting short continued growth; base sells on updated prospects and target allocations, not just gains from average cost.","I should avoid buying back stocks merely because they have fallen or because I sold them earlier; evaluate each purchase on its current risk, value, and role in the portfolio.","My account has risen overall, but a short record and infrequent trading make it hard to judge skill; review the portfolio periodically and make measured, diversified decisions rather than chasing recent moves."]}
